            Keep before selling

            Keep before selling

            Keep all useful ores/gems until you know your next recipe. Smithing commonly consumes five metal ores per ingot; arcforging's stated gem conversion is one-to-one. Common materials can serve unlocks, quests, equipment, and citizenship, so one stack may have several competing uses.

            Quests

            Quest log

            Accept kill quests before training. Reserve items before crafting or donating them. Level numbers are those stated in the supplied guides; if a quest's unlock or reward is not fully spoken, that gap remains explicit.

            Lv 10Profession unlocks and town errands5 quests

            Unlock all six professions when convenient. Secret emphasizes that the unlock tasks check items in your inventory rather than consuming them, so complete those checks before turning the same items into other quests or recipes.

            Perion: combine Silus's smithing task with stump/dark-stump errands such as Stump Horror Story and Fixing Blackbull's House. The later shield reward can avoid buying a Wooden Fence unnecessarily.

            Ellinia: keep leaves for Francois's tailoring unlock. Henesys: do Vicious's woodworking task. Kerning: do JM's leatherworking task. Sleepywood's arcforging unlock can wait until the trip is safe. Mr. Thunder handles weapons in Perion.

            Early town-scroll errands mentioned by Secret include Olaf's second training, Reason Behind the Mushroom Studies in Henesys, I Need Help with My Homework in Ellinia, and Don Hwang's request in Kerning. Nella charges 1,000 mesos to unlock her quest line; account for that cost.

            Recommended bySecret; profession details supported by Andy and Bucc.

            Starter maps
            Lv 16Pia and Blue Mushroom1 quest

            Pia in Henesys Park: collect 20 Green Mushroom Caps and 20 Blue Mushroom Caps. Ereklo reports 884 EXP, 468 mesos, and a random Helmet Accuracy scroll at 10%, 60%, or 100%, described as equally likely.

            Bundle this with the Mother's Gold Watch quest and mushroom training where possible. Secret notes that an early earring reward can delay buying another pair; compare actual stats before selling or replacing it.

            Recommended byEreklo, Secret; cap reserves also discussed by Woons.

            Blue mushroomsGreen mushroomsTree dungeons
            Lv 20Scrolls and first cape0 quests

            Jane and the Mushrooms, Lith Harbor: MSC places it at level 20. Ereklo describes 30 Blue Mushroom kills, 20 Horny Mushroom kills, and 15 caps of each type, rewarding 2,000 EXP and 585 mesos plus a weapon scroll.

            Reward: MSC described choosing a 60% weapon scroll, while Ereklo and Secret described a random one. The wiki's quest data settles it: you get one random weapon-attack scroll at 60% (Intermediate) from 14 possibilities, so you cannot pick your class's scroll.

            At 23, Stranger's Request: kill 40 Stirges and collect 20 Broken Mirrors. Follow with Stranger's Identity: kill 50 Zombie Mushrooms and collect 25 charms. The chain yields an Old Raggedy Cape with +1 accuracy; Secret places its equip level at 25. Delay the combat if it is inefficient rather than forcing it immediately at unlock.

            Recommended byEreklo, MSC, Secret.

            Blue MushroomsStirge trainingHorny and Zombie Mushrooms
            Lv 20Sleepywood mushroom kill chains0 quests

            Woons recommends accepting the 99-kill and subsequent 999-kill mushroom tasks before a long Ant Tunnel session. Do not assume kills earned before acceptance count retroactively.

            The archive does not fully narrate every chain reward and requirement, so no complete reward schedule is invented. Combine the relevant kills with Jane and the cape chain, and keep their mushroom items until those turn-ins are finished.

            Ant TunnelJanethe cape chainMushroom reserves
            Lv 21Proof of Companionship (King Slime)1 quest

            Accept the KPQ-associated King Slime task and kill King Slime once. Ereklo reports approximately 2,200 EXP, 614 mesos, one fame, and a random 60% earring stat scroll for STR, DEX, INT, or LUK.

            This is an extra reason to try KPQ even if you prefer normal training afterward. Secret recommends a ranged-heavy party for the buffed encounter; that is a suggested composition, not a universal requirement.

            KPQ and bonus-map notesKing Slime
            Lv 35Shumi's Lost Coin3 quests

            Finish the sequential B1, B2, and B3 subway jump quests rather than assuming the final reward can be collected alone. Ereklo highlights the final 10,000 mesos and 30 Mana Elixirs, plus other town-scroll/fame rewards across the sequence.

            The often-quoted 40,000 mesos is 10,000 direct mesos plus an estimated 30,000 NPC resale value for the elixirs. It is not a 40,000-meso cash payout. Keeping the potions has a different value if you will use them.

            Recommended byEreklo.

            Potion value
            Lv 36Rowan and Cursed Dolls5 quests

            Rowan/Rowen the Fairy's cursed-doll task in Ellinia: Ereklo describes killing 150 Zombie Lupins and collecting 150 Cursed Dolls for a 60% Gloves ATT or Gloves Magic ATT scroll. Check preceding quests in the chain; MSC notes ore rewards from prerequisites, while Elevny also mentions a level-40 hat in the broader progression.

            Accept before farming Zombie Lupins. Valley of Death and other Hollow mixes can progress this while working toward later Raffle/Aquamander quests. Do not sell the dolls as ordinary clutter if you intend to do the chain.

            Recommended byEreklo, MSC, Elevny.

            Hollow overlapForest of Evil alternative
            Lv 41Equipment and scroll errands0 quests

            At 41, Ronnie's Building a New House material deliveries (not Blackbull's separate level-48 house quest): MSC calls the longer shoe-speed 10%/60% reward chain optional. Check the time cost against your need for movement speed.

            At 42, Pia's Present/Gift: MSC highlights a cape-stat 10% scroll. The transcript does not provide a full ingredient list, so this is an unlock reminder rather than a fabricated walkthrough.

            At 44, Jane the Alchemist: a three-part chain with Gloves ATT or Magic ATT 10%/60% rewards in MSC's account. Elevny connects Drake Blood to this quest. Save it while training Drakes; other ingredients are not fully supplied in these transcripts.

            At 45, John's Last Present, which follows John's Present (a glove reward): MSC highlights Pansy Earrings with +3% critical damage. Red-Hearted Earrings at 50 are mentioned as a later alternative. Evaluate the actual item and class benefit rather than replacing them solely by level.

            Recommended byMSC; Drake overlap from Elevny.

            Drake Blood
            Lv 43Road Back Home2 quests

            First complete Natural Adhesive: kill 50 Raffles and collect 25 Raffle Petals. The Road Back Home task then calls for 50 Aquamanders and 50 Echopus in Forgotten Hollow, with a 10% earring stat scroll reward in Ereklo's account.

            Primeval Forest and suitable entrance maps combine these monster families. Use the map mix to advance several objectives; an elemental mismatch may still make a different party platform faster.

            Recommended byEreklo.

            Hollow maps and elemental sections
            Lv 46Icarus cape chain3 quests

            Start with In Search of the Wing Fairy and its quiz, then Ingredients for the Flying Machine and its quiz. Collect 50 Medicine with Weird Vibes from Wraiths and 20 Witchgrass Leaves by breaking herbs in the Kerning swamp. Finish Delivering the Flying Medicine.

            Ereklo describes a random cape: green for DEX/accuracy, yellow for speed/accuracy, or blue for INT/accuracy. Do not count on a chosen color. The exact numerical stats are not fully narrated here.

            Accept before a Wraith session and save the medicine. This is a particularly smooth overlap for a holy-damage route in the mid-to-late 40s.

            Recommended byEreklo; Wraith overlap from the map guides.

            Wraith mapsMaya's cape alternative
            Lv 47Maya's final collection1 quest

            MSC highlights Maya's Last Collection for a green Napoleon cape with DEX, describing green as the quest-obtainable color. The full collection list is not supplied in the transcript.

            Compare this with Icarus's random result before investing in a temporary cape.

            Icarus alternatives
            Lv 48Alligators and weapon scrolls0 quests

            Taking Out the Alligators I, starting from Perion: kill 40 Jr. Neckis and 100 Ligators, and provide 20 Jr. Necki Skins. Ereklo describes a choice of 10% weapon ATT or Magic ATT scroll.

            Part II: kill 120 Crocos and collect 50 Croco Skins for a choice of 60% cape-stat scroll. Keep quest skins separate from the batches you process in leatherworking.

            MSC also highlights Blackbull's Building a New House at 48 for a 10% weapon-attack scroll. The complete building materials are not narrated, so check the quest window rather than buying a guessed list.

            Recommended byEreklo, MSC.

            Reserve Necki skins earlier
            —Lower-priority or conditional errands0 quests

            MSC puts the Sauna/Bamboo robe route below the better scroll and stat-equipment quests because statless robes are less compelling when useful class gear is available. This is a priority judgment, not a claim that those quests are removed.

            Early travel-scroll errands, a useful shield reward, and profession checks can still pay off even if their EXP is modest. For long collection chains, accept first and collect during normal training rather than making a separate trip for every item.

            Tips

            Tips

            General advice comes from Dark, MSC, Woons, and Ducky. Keep quantities below are planning suggestions from the transcripts, not a demand to carry every item forever or a complete drop database.

            Potions and training costs

            MSC compares recovery per meso: Meat restores 160 HP at an implied price of 80 mesos, giving 2 HP per meso; Orange Potion restores 250 HP for 150 mesos, about 1.67 HP per meso. This favors Meat on nominal efficiency, provided the smaller recovery is adequate and you do not waste healing through overhealing.

            For MP, the quoted Lemon is 150 MP for 150 mesos; Blue Potion restores 200 MP for 220, about 0.91 MP per meso. Lemons are more efficient at those prices. Use the actual shop prices and recovery values before buying in bulk.

            Raise an attack skill when it reduces hits to kill or unlocks useful behavior. Extra MP spent for the same number of casts can be wasteful during a tight early budget. Physical characters can sometimes finish low-HP monsters with a basic attack; mages can benefit from exchanging unused HP consumables for MP supplies with other players.

            Woons mentions Pure Water and salads from specific shop/citizenship situations, but the transcript does not support a complete universal cheapest-potion table. Shumi's reward can be used or sold; do not count both its resale proceeds and its potion consumption as separate gains.

            Avoid unnecessary armor upgrades when they do not change survival or equip a useful stat bonus. Save a potion reserve before buying a rare star or powering a profession.

            Shumi reward value

            Travel, parties, and early progression

            Dark describes manual allocation of nine starting AP rather than rerolling dice. Leaving Maple Island is described as possible from 7 with 300 mesos and no return; other guides prefer completing its convenient quests first. Check your island-only chair/tasks before departure.

            Bucc notes a 90% beginner taxi discount; Woons recommends walking when later taxi spending is not justified. Early town-scroll quests save repeated travel. Use the chair, Recovery, and Nimble Feet where helpful, but do not let passive recovery consume more time than the money saved is worth to you.

            Party grinding is often favored in the beta accounts, but efficiency still depends on map coverage, not merely being in a party. Share platforms, avoid leaving a weak member on an unhittable monster, and move if competition defeats your kill rate.

            Citizenship and contributions

            Lv 12–22

            Dark places citizenship access around level 12, with Henesys favoring STR/DEX/accuracy-related benefits and Kerning favoring INT/LUK/critical-related benefits. Contributions come from daily/weekly activity, and rank progress may reset when advancing. Housing is described as unfinished; do not treat it as a complete released feature.

            Ducky's Kerning example: grade 2 "Visitor" around level 17 needs 1,000 contribution; grade 3 "Helpful Stranger" around level 22 needs 2,000 after the rank reset. The example uses daily 100/150 and weekly 500/750 contribution tasks, plus a Jake Stirge-phobia chain after grade 2. The exact day count depends on resets and completing the required tasks.

            Henesys has a comparable path involving Bruce after grade 2 in the Hunter guide. Roughly 12 days or two weeks is a scenario, not a guaranteed unlock time.

            Do not donate crafting or quest reserves blindly. Kerning's Wolbi access is a practical Assassin objective; Henesys can fit Hunter stat needs.

            Throwing stars and uncertain drop claims

            MSC's star discussion mixes Classic observations, old tables, and tentative sources. Several spoken probabilities contain decimal-conversion errors, so those rates are not reproduced as Classic drop chances. Market-price guesses are also omitted as live values.

            More directly discussed sources: Wolbi from Fire Boars; Wooden Tops from Dark Axe Stumps; Mokbi from Jr. Wraiths; Kumbi/Snowball from Lupins; Icicles from Cold Eyes; Steely from Red Drakes; Ilbi from Mushmom/Zombie Mushmom. Treat each as a reported source requiring in-game confirmation, not a promise of frequency.

            Less certain extensions: Snowball from Fire Boars; Mokbi from Cold Eyes/Stone Golems; Kumbi from Drakes/Fire Boars/Stone Golems; Tobi from regular Stone Golems or Wild Cargo; Steely from Tauromacis; Hwabi from Zombie Mushmom or Balrog. MSC is more confident about Dark Stone Golem Tobi than regular Stone Golem Tobi, while Elevny mentions regular golems.

            Ducky supplies a citizenship purchase route for Wolbi that is more specific than simply calling it shop-bought. Attack, stack capacity, refill cost, and availability all matter; expensive novelty stars at the same attack can cost more to recharge.

            Boss encounters

            Dark's reported beta list includes Mano at Beach Thicket III, King Slime in KPQ, Mushmom near Someone's House, Zombie Mushmom in the Sleepywood grave area, Rotten Mushmom in Forgotten Hollow, and Jr. Balrog in the Cursed Sanctuary.

            The listed monster levels are approximately 20, 32, 40, 50, 60, and 80 respectively. Monster level is not a recommended solo level. King Slime's task and Squishy Shoes give a concrete early reason to join a party.

            Timer disagreement: Dark describes roughly 30-minute spawns for several field bosses and three hours for Balrog; MSC says Mushmom and Zombie Mushmom are hourly. Do not plan a guaranteed timer route from this conflict.

            Reported rewards include Ilbi and equipment from the mushroom bosses, critical-damage earring scrolls from Zombie Mushmom, higher scrolls from Rotten Mushmom, and possible catalysts. The catalyst list is disputed, and Hwabi claims are uncertain.

            Settings and controls

            Ducky highlights HP/MP warning thresholds, monster name/health-bar display choices, damage-skin size, effect opacity, and placing pets behind the character to reduce clutter. Adjust these to make hazards and target health easier to read.

            Display options include resolution, full screen/Alt+Enter, VSync, UI scaling/fade, and map-memory/cache settings. The described cache range is 2–64 GB; choose for available storage rather than assuming the maximum is necessary.

            Screenshots include format/path, bursts of two to 10 images, and automatic level-up capture. Social controls include invitations, whispers, buddy/party/trade requests, login notices, timestamps, and chat fonts.

            Keyboard options include movement rebinding, roughly 45 mapped actions, three presets with switch keys, and Classic/Modern/Compact layouts. Quick slots expand from eight toward 12 with an additional row. Controller options include stick cursor/movement, different D-pad styles, and left/right quick controls; typing remains a separate limitation.

            Inspecting gear, citizenship badges, housing entries, and cash-shop prices in a beta UI does not prove their finished launch behavior. Cosmetic test prices are not purchasing advice.

            Market and scrolling judgment

            Common materials can have both NPC value and player demand. Compare the next recipe/quest use before selling, but avoid unlimited speculative hoarding. Claims that early assets will inevitably rise in price are predictions, not guaranteed returns.

            Read scroll type, success rate, stat affected, and destruction risk directly. Do not confuse attack power with weapon attack, or a quest's random reward with a chosen reward. A good scrolled lower-level weapon may outlast a clean upgrade, but compare speed and actual damage thresholds.
